source.extraction_scope: Unstructured HTML content from the Bosch Brand Guide page about imagery style, organized into AI-readable guidance.
extraction_notes: The JSON captures visible text, sidebar structure, downloadable references, explicit rules, checklists, and image asset metadata available in the HTML.
Some page hyperlinks were present as text-only references in the saved HTML and are represented descriptively rather than as resolved URLs.
Image content itself was not interpreted visually; only file names, dimensions, and available alt text were extracted.

executive_summary.core_story: Bosch imagery should depict authentic living and product worlds. It should show real environments, diverse natural situations, people, and Bosch products in use, expressing the Invented for life promise through vivid, realistic, positive, and high-quality visual language.
core_visual_formula: People using Bosch products or products shown in realistic use contexts
Modern, high-quality exposure and image treatment
Focused, reduced explanatory visuals when the purpose is technical or product-centered
executive_summary.primary_ai_usage: Use this file as a retrieval-ready style reference for generating, selecting, evaluating, or briefing Bosch-compliant imagery.

authenticity.rule: Imagery must feel authentic, lifelike, and true to real living or working situations.
apply_by: Use real environments instead of artificial backdrops.
Avoid over-staged scenarios and unrealistic perspectives.
Prefer real or fully retouched images over artificial filters or composings.

human_and_product_focus.rule: The focus is on people and their product applications, or on Bosch products shown through meaningful use moments.
apply_by: Show people using Bosch products in natural surroundings.
Use product application shots to communicate benefits and functionality.
For product-only moments, create dynamic living moments that showcase the product without human actors.

color.rule: Use vivid, saturated colors to create a lively atmosphere and positive brand perception.
color.accent_guidance: Optional targeted color accents may be used to draw attention to specific products or details, based on Bosch accent colors or the Supergraphic. They may appear in styling, props, or accessories, but must not feel artificial.
color.restriction: No strict color-code requirement is stated for imagery style; emphasis is on purposeful color accentuation rather than exact codes.

light_and_contrast.rule: Use optimal exposure and pleasant contrast. Images should look natural, modern, and high quality.

composition_and_perspective.rule: Composition should be appealing, detailed, active, and telling.
checkpoints: Is the image composition appealing and detailed?
Is the perspective well chosen, active, and telling?
Is the close-up or detail shot focused and exciting?

sections.title: Imagery style
sections.purpose: Set the overall Bosch imagery direction.
sections.source_summary: Authentic living and product worlds express how Bosch Invented for life improves quality of life. Visual language uses real environments, diverse natural situations, people, and product applications.

sections.title: The Bosch image world
sections.purpose: Define the overarching look and color atmosphere.
sections.source_summary: The Bosch image style uses vivid, saturated colors to create a lively atmosphere. Optional accents may align with the Supergraphic, emphasizing elements without strict color-code requirements.
design_rules: Use optional color accents to emphasize details or products.
Use accents purposefully and do not make them look artificial.

subsections.title: Colors
rules: Use saturated colors to create a lively mood and positive brand perception.
Use Bosch accent-color-inspired accents in styling, props, or accessories when attention should be drawn to specific products or details.

subsections.title: Light & contrast
rules: Keep the image style appealing, natural, modern, and high quality.

subsections.title: AI-generated images governance
rules: Only use AI image generation tools approved by BD for this purpose.
Follow internal guidelines and legal notices, especially the Legal AI FAQ in Docupedia.
Use other AI image generation tools only in consultation with the relevant C/LS Business Lawyer.
subsections.risk_area: Legal and compliance governance for AI-generated imagery.

sections.title: Moods & image motifs
sections.source_summary: Imagery should be authentic, lifelike, emotionally appealing, and positive. People are shown in natural surroundings and life situations while using Bosch products.

motif_types.name: True to life
motif_types.description: Realistic and vivid situations from everyday life.

motif_types.name: Joie de vivre
motif_types.description: Positive charisma and a healthy lifestyle.

motif_types.name: Evening and night shots
motif_types.description: Respect Bosch tonality. Avoid black, excessive darkness, and hard contrast.

motif_types.name: Portraits
motif_types.description: Person in focus, with architecture or work environment in the background, optionally blurred.

motif_types.name: Press and business photography
motif_types.description: Work situations staged dynamically with depth of field.

motif_types.name: Living moments
motif_types.description: Dynamic shots that showcase Bosch products without human actors.

motif_types.name: Campaigns
motif_types.description: Staged through visual, high-contrast, and dynamic exaggeration.

sections.title: Product application
rules: Use focused shots of people using Bosch products.

sections.title: Technical and product explanatory motifs
sections.source_summary: Depending on the application, Bosch uses packshot product free plates, details and close-ups, or 3D renderings. The design should be highly reduced, with a clear visual language that directs attention to the product.
checklist: General: Is the image or film material authentic and lifelike?
Color: Are the colors strong and vivid?
Light & contrast: Are light and contrast natural and pleasant?
Composition: Is the image composition appealing and detailed?
Perspective: Is the perspective well chosen, active, and telling?
Details & close-ups: Is the focus of the close-up or detail shot exciting?
Copyright: Have all required usage rights been clarified?
sections.production_recommendation: Use only real or fully retouched images to represent the brand appropriately. Avoid artificial filters, black-and-white treatment, and composings to maintain authenticity.
donts: Artificial, over-staged, unrealistic situation and perspective.
Duplex effect and layering with different images.
Person in front of artificial background and graphic free-style elements.

sections.title: Visualization of invisible elements: Pixel Code
sections.purpose: Make invisible elements such as AI, data, processes, or energy flows visible.
sections.source_summary: Pixel Code visualizes invisible elements using clear rules for grids, depth, and transparency. General image-style principles still apply to photos.
basic_principles: Pixel Code is basically white and may have slight transparency depending on motif brightness.
Pixel Code complements the motif and must never take center stage.
Choose pixel sizes so they do not compete with other graphic elements and still work in small formats.
Align Pixel Code with the image motif and context, for example with people or figures.
Control spacing and transparency deliberately to create depth and dynamism.
For very simple or minimalist motifs, a single Pixel Code layer may be used if it remains subtle and supports the image effect without overlaying the motif.
opacity_rules: Adjust transparency so Pixel Code has the same luminosity across different image backgrounds.
Pixel Code supports the image motif and must not overlay it.
Dark images: 60 percent, 80 percent, or 100 percent opacity may be used depending on motif.
Bright images: 60 percent, 80 percent, or 100 percent opacity may be used depending on motif.
photoshop_figma_instructions: Separate the motif into foreground and background.
Use two Pixel Code layers, one foreground and one background.
Keep a one-pixel distance from the edge of the image.
Use masks to adjust the desired amount of overlay.
Set opacity depending on the motif.
Use the Master_Pixel_Code.zip template when available.
Adjust masks and opacity to suit the motif.
donts: Pixel transparency too low or too high.
Pixels too large and competing with other graphic elements.
Other pixel shapes such as circles or lines.
sections.future_evolution_note: Because Artificial Intelligence is continuously developing, this area is expected to expand continuously.

sections.title: Visualization of invisible elements: KERAS Code
sections.purpose: Alternative visualization method for invisible elements.
sections.source_summary: KERAS Code is represented by one or two layers in the relevant motif area, blending harmoniously with the content. Each use is tailored to the motif, with focus and message defined.
layer_system: KERAS-Code Layer consists of parts typical for artificial intelligence.
A Light Points Layer may additionally be added in the background.
photoshop_tutorial_rules: Select and align effects for natural, transparent glow.
Adjust to the light situation of the subject without becoming dominant.
Use partial darkening and blurring if necessary.
Quietness and darkness enhance the effect.
Light is slightly transparent and adapts to the motif.
Use the blend mode Negative Multiply in Photoshop.
Connect the layer with the background.
Select appropriate opacity according to the motif.
Use Bosch Blue accent color and its gradations as a guide.
Option 1: realize the layer effect with Appearance outwards.
Option 2: realize the layer effect with Gaussian blur.
Adjust blue tones via Hue/Saturation plus Tint color adjustment layer.
The farther away from the focus point, the more transparent the layer/code and the stronger the blur.
sections.masking_tip: All effect layers require motif-specific handling. Work out the relevant area through layer-mask transparency. Masks cannot be global and must always be individual.
sections.future_evolution_note: Because Artificial Intelligence is continuously developing, this area is expected to expand continuously.

sections.title: Framing
sections.source_summary: When creating and producing new images and movies, different media formats must be considered.

sections.title: Technical requirements
sections.source_summary: Image and film productions must meet basic technical requirements for data creation and delivery.

sections.title: Image databases
sections.source_summary: Bosch has enterprise purchasing agreements with stock image providers, allowing stock images to be purchased at lower prices with required Bosch-wide usage rights without limitations.
rules: Use the central internal library when available to download images directly.
The same collection is linked in the PowerPoint Design Kit.
Additional images can be purchased at own expense and via division-specific access from Depositphotos or Getty Images.
Images already purchased can be downloaded and reused by other Bosch users when rights allow.

global_dos: Show real living environments and diverse natural situations.
Focus on people and product applications.
Use vivid, saturated colors and lively mood.
Use natural, pleasant light and contrast.
Keep images modern and high quality.
Use focused product application shots to explain benefits and functionality.
Use reduced, clear visual language for technical and product explanatory motifs.
Use Pixel Code or KERAS Code subtly when visualizing invisible elements.
global_donts: Do not use artificial, over-staged, unrealistic situations or perspectives.
Do not use artificial backgrounds with graphic free-style elements for people.
Do not use generic stock-image technology visualizations.
Do not use black-and-white treatment for brand imagery.
Do not use artificial neon and blur effects.
Do not use duplex effects or layer different images in a way that feels composited.
Do not let Pixel Code or KERAS Code dominate, distort, or reduce readability.
Do not deviate from Bosch Blue when using KERAS Code effects.

positive_prompt_components: People using product naturally, if relevant
Pleasant natural light and balanced contrast
Clear focus on product benefit or usage
No artificial staging or generic stock visualization
evaluation_questions: Does the image feel authentic and lifelike?
Are colors strong and vivid but not artificial?
Are light and contrast natural and pleasant?
Is the composition appealing and detailed?
Is the perspective active and telling?
Does the image show product benefit or product function clearly?
Are invisible-element overlays subtle, contextual, and non-dominant?
Are rights and usage permissions clarified for produced or purchased content?

image_assets_extracted.alt_text: True to life: Realistic and vivid situations from everyday life.
Joie de vivre: positive charisma and a healthy lifestyle.
Product staging: snapshots of products in use.
Evening and night shots: Note Bosch tonality. No black, not too dark or hard contrast.
Portraits: person in focus, background with architecture or work environment (optionally blurred).
Press and business photography: work situations staged dynamically with depth of field.
Living moments: Dynamic shots that showcase Bosch products - without human actors.
